Is Short mein seekho:
✅ CREATE TABLE naam ( ... );
✅ Har column: naam + type

📌 SQL Series Part 7: INSERT INTO  (Create & Insert)

Is Short mein seekho:
✅ INSERT INTO table (cols) VALUES (...)
✅ Text aur date 'single quotes' mein
✅ Kai rows: ( ),( ) comma se
✅ Column list likho, safe raho

💻 Example query:
INSERT INTO employees
(id, name, dept, salary, city)
VALUES
(1,'Aarav','IT',60000,'Delhi'),

✔️ Sahi tareeka: VALUES (3, 'Kabir', 'Sales')
💡 Kyun: Standard SQL mein "double" = column naam. PostgreSQL error dega, text hamesha 'single' ✅

✅ AS = column ka temporary naam
✅ Sirf result mein, table same
✅ Calculation ke saath must
✅ Alias WHERE mein nahi chalta

  name AS employee_name,
  salary * 12 AS yearly_salary

✅ Stop condition zaroori
✅ Use: org chart, tree, dates

WITH RECURSIVE nums AS (

📌 SQL Series Part 75: Transactions (COMMIT / ROLLBACK)  (Transactions)

Is Short mein seekho:
✅ BEGIN = shuru
✅ COMMIT = pakka save
✅ ROLLBACK = sab wapas
✅ All or nothing, beech ka nahi

💻 Example query:
BEGIN;
UPDATE accounts
  SET balance = balance - 200
  WHERE name = 'A';
UPDATE accounts
  SET balance = balance + 200
  WHERE name = 'B';
COMMIT;

❌ Common mistake: BEGIN; UPDATE accounts ...; -- COMMIT gayab
✔️ Sahi tareeka: BEGIN; UPDATE accounts ...; COMMIT;
💡 Kyun: COMMIT nahi kiya → session band hote hi rollback, aur tab tak rows lock 🔒
